name: rosetta-identity-matrix
code:
use default

identity(size: int) -> Ghul.Pipes.Pipe[string] =>
    (0..size)
        |> map(row =>
            (0..size)
                |> map(column => if row == column then "1" else "0" fi)
                |> join(" "))

for row in identity(5) do
    write_line(row)
od
